200.description: The report for the requested window. An empty window is a 200 with an empty `rows` array, not a 404.

rows.description: One row per (scope, day bucket), ordered by day bucket then scope. Always present; empty for a window with no data.

scope.description: Site code, zone id, or the empty string for catalog-wide definitions.

dayBucket.description: Start (midnight UTC) of the day this row aggregates.

importRowsSubmitted.description: Rows submitted across this bucket's bulk imports.

importRowsImported.description: Rows imported across this bucket's bulk imports.

importRowsRejected.description: Rows rejected across this bucket's bulk imports.

400.description: The query is malformed or missing a required parameter (`invalid-report-query`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem detail, identical in shape to the OLTP API's.

type.description: Stable identifier for the error category.

title.description: Fixed human-readable summary of the error category.
title.example: The report query is malformed or missing a required parameter

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path this problem occurred on.

schema.title: Problem

500.description: The report could not be served (`report-store-error`).
